Method of Attack: Exploiting browser 'Restore Session' feature that caches non-password input fields to disk, causing wallet recovery phrases to be saved in plain text on disk
Attackers or malware with access to the computer can steal the seed phrase and import the wallet on their own devices
Attack Vector: Browser wallet extensions using non-password input fields for recovery phrase entry
Physical theft of computer, remote access, or compromise via remote access trojan
User enabling 'Show Secret Recovery Phrase' checkbox during wallet import
